_HOW_TO_FILL_THIS_IN: Replace every ENTER ... text with your own words. Keep the quotation marks.
category must be one of: drinks, desserts, meals
amount is how much, for example: 2 tbsp, 1 cup, a handful
grayArea must be one of: exact, some, very
exact = measure carefully, don't change it
some  = you can adjust it a little
very  = change it, swap it, or skip it however you like
Need more ingredients or steps? Copy a whole { ... } block, paste it right after, and put a comma between them.
Need more recipes? Copy a whole recipe block { ... } and put a comma after the one before it.
No comma after the LAST item in a list.

recipes.name: Maple Sea Salt Iced Latte
recipes.blurb: The perfect sweet and salty latte

ingredients.amount: 1/2 CUP - OR WHATEVER YOUR HEART DESIRES

instructions.step: Pour maple syrup and your sea salt into the bottom of the cup you will use to brew your espresso.
Once espresso is brewed, pour into empty cup and add your desired amount of milk (less is more).
Add ice and enjoy!

recipes.name: Raspberry Chocolate Chip Protein Bites
recipes.blurb: Protein packed bites that are great as a preworkout snack or dessert

instructions.step: Mix all ingredients together in a bowl until well combined.
Grab small handfuls of the mixture and roll into balls.
Place the protein balls on a baking sheet and put in fridge overnight for best results.
Combine all ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Strain into a jar and let cool. Store in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.name: Avocado Toast
recipes.blurb: An easy and healthy everyday breakfast

ingredients.item: Everything but the bagel seasoning, olive oil, sliced tomato, egg, etc.

instructions.step: Toast the bread to your desired level of crispiness.
Slice the avocado in half, remove the pit, and scoop the rest into a bowl. Mash with a fork until smooth.
Spread the avocado mixture on the toast and sprinkle with your preferred toppings.

recipes.name: Brown Sugar Oat Milk Shaken Espresso

instructions.step: Brew espresso over a cup with the brown sugar & cinnamon inside.
Pour the espresso over ice in a shaker or jar with a lid and shake for 10-15 seconds until foamy.
Pour into a glass and top with oat milk. Enjoy!

recipes.name: Strawberry Banana Protein Smoothie
recipes.blurb: A fruity post-workout smoothie that keeps you full

instructions.step: Add milk to the blender first, then the rest of the ingredients.
Blend until smooth, adding more milk if it's too thick.
Pour into a cup and enjoy!

recipes.name: Pesto Caprese Pasta
recipes.blurb: A fresh 15-minute pasta that tastes like summer

instructions.step: Cook pasta according to the package directions, then drain.
Toss the warm pasta with pesto until coated.
Stir in tomatoes and mozzarella, then top with a drizzle of balsamic glaze.

recipes.name: Hot Honey Chicken Wrap
recipes.blurb: A sweet and spicy lunch you can make in minutes

instructions.step: Toss the chicken in hot honey until coated.
Layer spinach, chicken, and feta down the center of the tortilla.
Fold in the sides, roll it up tight, and toast seam-side down in a pan for 1-2 minutes.

recipes.name: Frozen Yogurt Bark
recipes.blurb: A cold and creamy treat that feels light

instructions.step: Mix yogurt and honey together, then spread about 1/2 inch thick on a parchment-lined baking sheet.
Sprinkle berries, chocolate chips, and/or granola on top.
Freeze for at least 3 hours, then break into pieces. Store in the freezer.

recipes.name: 2-Minute Mug Brownie
recipes.blurb: A warm single-serve brownie for when the craving hits

instructions.step: Mix flour, cocoa powder, and sugar in a large microwave-safe mug.
Stir in milk and melted butter until smooth, then top with chocolate chips.
Microwave for 60-90 seconds until set but still fudgy. Let cool for a minute before eating.
